turns.assessment: The failure is isolated to svc296: numerous services sharing its S07–S03–S24 working route remain healthy, and line-interface, optical power, OSNR, BER, and protection-path instrumentation show no change. The decisive discriminator is EQPT_PORT_FAIL at the svc296 client port at S07, coincident with CLIENT_SF at both ends; the S24 CLIENT_SF is consistent with the propagated service interruption. This strongly identifies the S07 client port rather than an optical or shared OTN-path fault.

proposals.rationale: This port raised the explicit EQPT_PORT_FAIL alarm at onset. A hard failure here explains the local and remote CLIENT_SF while leaving all shared optical paths and neighboring services unaffected.

An endpoint port failure at S24 could isolate only svc296 and create client failure indications, but it is strongly disfavored because the equipment-port-failure alarm was raised specifically at S07, not S24.
